CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 02 / 11

Demand elasticity

Classifying elasticity彈性分類

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Classify demand as elastic (> 1), inelastic (< 1), unit elastic (= 1), perfectly inelastic (= 0) or perfectly elastic. Identify horizontal and vertical extreme cases.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

Ed 大於一有彈性，小於一缺乏彈性，等於一為單位彈性。垂直需求完全無彈性；水平需求完全有彈性。圖線斜度還受單位及軸比例影響。

Ed>1 is elastic, Ed<1 inelastic, and Ed=1 unit elastic. Vertical demand is perfectly inelastic with Ed=0. Horizontal demand is perfectly elastic in the idealized limit. Classify using percentage responses, not visual angle alone.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A 10% price rise reduces Q by 3%, so Ed=0.3 and demand is inelastic. 價升一成、量跌百分之三。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A perfectly vertical demand curve has which elasticity? 垂直需求彈性？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
